app_tagline: Convert your Genshin Impact wish history into a Paimon.moe Excel file.
lang_unknown: [!] Language '{lang}' is not available; using English.
prompt_source: Drag & drop the file here, or type its path/name (or 'q' to quit):
prompt_source_again: File not found. Try again, or type 'q' to quit:
candidates_header: Excel/CSV files found in this folder:
candidates_pick: Enter a number, a path, or 'q' to quit:
source_is_output: The source and output files are the same.
no_pulls: No valid pulls found in the source file.
output_exists: The output file already exists. Overwrite? [y/N]
output_renamed: Writing to a new file instead: {file}
import_note: Import note: Paimon.moe only appends pulls newer than the newest and older than the oldest already in your account. Clear your Paimon.moe data first for a full import.
unknown_items: Unknown items: {items}. Run the tool online once to update the item database, or report the issue.
cache_missing: [!] No cached Paimon.moe data. Run online once, or pass --reference.
generic_banners: [!] No banner data available: using generic names (the importer ignores them).
unsupported_format: Unsupported file type: {ext}. Use the .xlsx or .csv export from the game.
py_too_old: Python {found} found, but Python 3.9+ is required.
dep_explain: openpyxl is a small open-source library used to read and write Excel files. It will be installed only inside this folder, not system-wide.
venv_explain: A local virtual environment (.venv) keeps the dependency isolated from your system.
venv_failed: Could not create the virtual environment: {error}
venv_debian_hint: On Debian/Ubuntu, install it with: sudo apt install python3-venv
dep_declined: Installation declined. The converter cannot run without openpyxl.
check_missing: Some components are missing; run the tool normally to install them.
pip_missing: pip is not available; trying to bootstrap it with ensurepip...
dep_manual: You can also install it manually with: {cmd}
help_body:
Usage:
  run.py [options] [file]

Options:
  file.xlsx|.csv   source file (you will be asked if omitted)
  -o, --output     output file
  --offline        do not download Paimon.moe data
  --reference      use a Paimon.moe export as banner source
  --server         Asia, China, America, Europe
  --data-dir       read Paimon.moe data from a folder
  --lang           en, it, fr, de, es, pt, ru
  --yes            overwrite and install without asking
  --check          environment check only
  --version        show the version
